blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks bounced back on Friday as bargain hunters returned after five straight sessions of losses, while strong foreign buying provided additional support. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) climbed 1.67 percent, or 95.95 points, to close at 5,825.97. READ: Diesel may drop by P7/liter next week Philstocks Financial Inc. described the recovery as a technical bounce, with investors picking up battered shares following the market’s long decline.
